name: Proactive grant review (client message → team channel)

inputMapping.instruction: Decide if the client is signalling a grant milestone that needs OUR review (e.g. 'finished the abstract', 'ready for review', 'submitted section X'). Return { reviewNeeded: boolean, milestone: string, reason: string }.

data.label: Only continue if a review is actually needed
Flag it on the TEAM channel (FIREWALL: never the client channel)
Run the Stellar grant advisor on the grant doc
Post the AI review to the TEAM channel

metadata.purpose: PROACTIVE: when a client posts a milestone in their comms channel ('finished abstract', 'needs review'), the AI detects it, pre-reviews the grant with the Stellar advisor skill, and surfaces BOTH the flag and the review on the TEAM channel — so nobody has to launch an agent. FIREWALL: all AI output goes to the team channel, NEVER the client-comms source channel.
prerequisites: FIREWALL (non-negotiable): every output node targets the team channel via automation.state.teamChannelId — NEVER {{trigger.channel}}. Do not repoint these at the source channel.

GAP 1 — client resolution: a `resolve-client` step must map the SOURCE channel → its client entity → grantDocUrl (set by 'Stellar grant — provision client Drive') → the client's team thread. Channels link to clients via the `links` table; the automation DSL has no link-traversal/query node for this yet. This is the #1 substrate limitation this feature reveals — needs a resolution verb (e.g. builtin `client.resolveFromChannel`) before the template runs end-to-end.

GAP 2 — `automation.state` is not seeded by bridge-setup: the create endpoint drops `state`, so `teamChannelId` must be set post-create (or via an update path that accepts state). Same limitation blocks the Drive-provision automation's clientsFolderId/grantTemplateFileId.
GAP 3 — the review skill (stellar-scf-grants-advisor) must read the grant doc: needs Google connected + a `docs_get` fetch of the grant content passed to the skill.
GAP 4 — activation: seeded as `draft`; activate once the resolution + team channel are wired.
The `detect`/`review` skill nodes reference `qualify-reply` (Agency capability) + `stellar-scf-grants-advisor` — both seeded; confirm the condition node evaluates `steps.detect.output.reviewNeeded`.
